name: html-artifact-editor
description: Local-first HTML text correction tool — toolchain scaffold

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.core.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && tsc -p tsconfig.ui.json
scripts.test:security: node tools/build.mjs security security-preload && node tools/run-electron.mjs --security
scripts.test:mapping: node tools/build.mjs parser-worker preload-preview mapping && node tools/run-electron.mjs --mapping
scripts.test:patch: node tools/build.mjs parser-worker preload-preview patch && node tools/run-electron.mjs --patch
scripts.test:draft: node tools/build.mjs parser-worker draft-worker preload-preview draft && node tools/run-electron.mjs --draft
scripts.test:editor: node tools/build.mjs parser-worker draft-worker preload-preview editor editor-probe && node tools/run-electron.mjs --editor
scripts.test:workspace: node tools/build.mjs parser-worker draft-worker history-worker preload-preview workspace && node tools/run-electron.mjs --workspace
scripts.test:session: node tools/build.mjs parser-worker draft-worker history-worker preload-preview session session-probe && node tools/run-electron.mjs --session
scripts.test:project: node tools/build.mjs parser-worker draft-worker history-worker preload-preview preload-ui project && node tools/run-electron.mjs --project
scripts.test:save-session: node tools/build.mjs native parser-worker draft-worker history-worker preload-preview preload-ui save-session && node tools/run-electron.mjs --save-session
scripts.test:recovery: node tools/build.mjs native parser-worker draft-worker history-worker preload-preview preload-ui recovery recovery-child && node tools/run-electron.mjs --recovery
scripts.test:source-diff: node tools/build.mjs native parser-worker draft-worker history-worker diff-worker preload-preview preload-ui source-diff && node tools/run-electron.mjs --source-diff
scripts.test:history: node tools/build.mjs native parser-worker draft-worker history-worker diff-worker preload-preview preload-ui history history-child && node tools/run-electron.mjs --history
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run check:boundaries && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:security && npm run test:mapping && npm run test:patch && npm run test:draft && npm run test:editor && npm run test:workspace && npm run test:session && npm run test:project && npm run test:storage && npm run test:save-session && npm run test:recovery && npm run test:source-diff && npm run test:history && npm run licenses:check
